name: cogitator-validator
description: A single-plugin marketplace publishing the cogitator-validator skill: a pregroup-grammar decision tree that scores eleven Lean kernel checkers using persistent homology of rellm-tagged cogitator reasoning steps, with classical and QPE Betti estimators.

plugins.name: cogitator-validator
plugins.description: Validate Lean checker outputs against a topological model of cogitator reasoning steps. Provides decision-tree suggestions, signal-flow diagnostics, and a QPE-based Betti estimator for higher-dimensional reasoning point clouds.
